08The latest story The Reeves, Hanworth

News

The latest story.

All news →
Sue’s Angels FC Confirm Pre-Season Fixtures Sue’s Angels FC can confirm our pre-season fixture schedule as preparations begin for the 2026/27 season. After a memorable campaign that saw the club continue its rise, attention now turns to the hard work ahead. The coming weeks will provide the squad with valuable opportunities to build fitness, develop match sharpness, and continue strengthening the foundations that have been established over the past year. The management team has arranged six fixtures throughout August, with a mixture of home and away matches against a range of opposition. Confirmed Fixtures 2nd August Pure Football (A) 9th August Galacticos (A) 12th August Kingsmeadow (H) 16th August Brentford Town (A) 23rd August Kew Antigua (A) 30th August BPR (H) Looking Ahead Pre-season is about far more than results. It is an opportunity for players to return to the pitch, for new faces to settle into the group, and for the squad to continue developing ahead of another important season. Every fixture will provide valuable minutes and help the management team assess preparations as the countdown to the new campaign continues. We look forward to seeing supporters at the games and thank everyone for their continued backing as we begin the next chapter together. The journey continues. 20 Jul 2026 · Sue's Angels FC

11Player of the Month Est. 2025

March 25/26

Player of the Month.

Every award →
Daniel McLane

Congratulations to Dan on being named Sue’s Angels FC Player of the Month for March, making it two awards in a row after also winning in February. Dan continued his outstanding season with a series of influential performances from centre-back. Despite playing in defence, he contributed an impressive 4 goals, helped the team keep 3 clean sheets, and picked up a Man of the Match award along the way. His leadership, consistency and quality at both ends of the pitch were key as Sue’s Angels FC went through March unbeaten, making this latest accolade thoroughly deserved. Congratulations, Dan!

faq:
38Ask the Angels The Reeves, Hanworth

Ask the Angels.

Where are Sue's Angels FC based?+

We're a men's Sunday league football club in south-west London, playing our home matches at The Reeves in Hanworth.

What league do you play in?+

After winning League Ten unbeaten in our debut 25/26 season, we now compete in League Eight of the Southern Sunday Football League.

Why were Sue's Angels founded?+

The club was founded in 2025 in memory of Susan Anne Martin. We play to keep her name alive and to raise awareness of sepsis.

How can I join?+

New players and volunteers are always welcome. Get in touch through the Join the Club section below, or message us on Instagram @suesangelsfc.

Who sponsors the club?+

We're proudly backed by Sporting Solutions, Bloomin' Marvellous, Hodgson Roofing and Staines Rugby.

60Four ways in P18 W18 · Unbeaten

Get involved

Four ways in.

The whole thing →
  • Play for the Angels

    We look at players across every position ahead of each season. Tell us your position, your age and where you have played, and we will come back to you about a trial.

  • Join the media team

    Photography, video, editing and matchday content. If you want portfolio work on a real matchday every week, this is a good place to build it.

  • Volunteer with us

    Coaching, kit, fixtures, socials, fundraising. A Sunday-league club runs on people giving up their time, and there is always more to do.

  • Sponsor the club

    Put your business behind a club with a cause at its heart, and help us carry Sue’s message further.
joinfaqs:
61Questions about joining Est. 2025

Questions about joining.

How do I arrange a trial?+

Send the form and say what position you play. We will come back to you with the next session that suits, usually inside 48 hours. There is nothing to pay to trial.

Do I need experience for the media team?+

No. If you can shoot on a phone, edit, design or write, there is a role for you, and we will help you grow into it.

What do volunteers get?+

A proper football family, matchday access, and a genuine role in a club going places.

How do sponsorships work?+

There is no fixed rate card. The packages on the sponsors page are shapes rather than price bands, and we build the detail around your business across kit, signage, content and community.

How quickly will I hear back?+

Usually inside 48 hours. Everything on this page goes to the same inbox and a person reads it, so if it takes a little longer over a matchday weekend, it has not been missed.
